page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6v-c8g1.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon 8163 processor, delivering 32 dedicated vCPUs across 16 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The CPU operates at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz and is equipped with 33 MB of L3 cache. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 4.0 GB per core. For acceleration, it bundles four NVIDIA Volta V100 GPUs, offering a combined total of 64 GB of VRAM. This instance does not include local NVMe storage and relies on network-attached storage, supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates moderate multi-core processing capabilities alongside weaker single-core performance. The stress-ng single-core CPU test places the instance in the bottom 25% with a score of 1103.89, and single-threaded gzip compression registers in the bottom 10% at 19.1 GB/sec. However, multi-threaded performance scales to average levels, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 23575.63 and a PassMark CPU score of 21092.78. Memory performance is stable, showing an average read-only large block bandwidth of 118.4 GB/sec and a write bandwidth of 57.05 GB/sec. Database and web serving operations also perform in the middle tier, with Redis SET operations achieving 22.1 million operations per second and static web serving throughput reaching 15.55 GB/sec.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn6v-c8g1.8xlarge represents a specialized hardware profile where value is concentrated in its dense GPU configuration rather than raw single-core CPU speed. The inclusion of four enterprise-grade NVIDIA V100 GPUs makes it a suitable fit for parallel computing tasks, machine learning model training, and GPU-accelerated data processing. Conversely, it is less optimal for single-threaded applications or workloads requiring high local storage performance due to the absence of local SSDs.
